Celebrity Homes Targeted By Thieves

By
Sharon
-
Jul 27, 2026
0
Facebook
X
Pinterest
WhatsApp
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 2:35
    Instaread

    BEVERLY HILLS—On July 26, the New York Post reported an increase in burglaries of celebrities living in upscale areas of southern California. Actress, Morgan Stewart spoke recently on Jake Shane’s Therapus, podcast reporting a second burglary at her Trousdale Estates home.

    In her July 24 interview, Stewart indicated that she had two separate break-ins where thieves stole a rare Hermès Birkin bag and her husband’s luxury watch collection.  The actress indicated she was away on a school camping trip with her children when the theft happened.  The actress revealed intruders entered her home while a security guard was on duty, after he fell asleep.  They ransacked her home, stealing designer handbags, and other valuables.

    On July 14, the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department reported that nearly $500,000 in luxury items, designer handbags, jewelry and clothing were stolen from rappers, and Chicago native, Lucki Camel Jr.

    Camel reportedly discovered the theft when he returned home on July 14, at approximately 10:30 p.m.  Anyone with information is asked to call the West Hollywood Station at 310-855-8850.

    On January 30, at approximately 7:10 p.m., “Suits” star, Gina Torres’ Sherman Oaks’ home was burglarized and ransacked. Approximately $225,000 in jewelry and $25,000 in cash were stolen.  A neighbor called the police, and surveillance captured two male suspects leaving in a white sedan.

    On November 15, 2025, “Real Housewives of Beverly Hills” star Sutton Stracke had her 4-bedroom, 6-bath, Georgian-style historical mansion broken into.

    Rick Hilton, and his wife Kathy Hilton who are also the parents of Paris Hilton had their Bel-Air home burglarized on the same day as Stracke.  Both were away in Las Vegas when their homes were burglarized.

    On August 22, 2025, singer Lionel Richi’s home was broken into.  The Beverly Hills Police Department reported the arrest of Michael John Bond, 38, who was held on a $50,000 bond.

    Reports indicate that the burglar alarm scared off the intruder before any damage was done. Nothing was stolen from the estate.

    The Los Feliz home of actor, Brad Pitt was burglarized on June 25, 2025.  In August 2025, four suspects, Jaquory Arman Watson, 18, Damari Zair Charles, 18, and two minors were arrested.  Watson and Charles were booked into jail on charges of first-degree burglary. It is unknown what became of the juveniles involved in the theft.

    Country music star, Keith Urban and actress Nicole Kidman’s home in Beverly Crest was broken into on February 14, 2025, at approximately 8 p.m.  This is not the couple’s primary residence. Reports indicate that their home was burglarized and ransacked, while away.
